_comment: Per-field value guide (generated by scripts/build_value_guide.py from schema.json). Tells a filler what each field should contain, with formats, address components, calculations to validate, and adversarial values to avoid. Not legal advice.

county_probate_court.label: County Probate Court
county_probate_court.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

docket_number.label: Docket Number
avoid: a docket from another jurisdiction's format

estate_name.label: Estate Name
estate_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

petitioner_contact.label: Petitioner Contact
petitioner_contact.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

petitioner_interest.label: Petitioner Interest
petitioner_interest.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

petitioner_interest_other.label: Petitioner Interest Other
petitioner_interest_other.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

court_requests.label: Court Requests
court_requests.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

attorney_name.label: Attorney Name
attorney_name.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

attorney_address.label: Attorney Address
attorney_address.expects: an address with: street, city, state, zip
avoid: the state spelled out ('Maine') when an abbreviation fits
a PO box where a physical/legal residence is required

attorney_bar_number.label: Maine Bar Number
attorney_bar_number.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

attorney_email.label: Email Address
attorney_email.expects: free text answering the printed prompt
